reviews.comment: I took Gabbai for my inorganic lab. He is genuinely one of the most accommodating and understanding professors I've had in my college career. He likes to teach and he wants to help as much as he can, which I think is so important and rare.

Professor Gabbai is a very respected chemist at TAMU but I don't think he should be teaching basic chem. He went straight out of the book and referred to it ALOT throughout the year. He lectures very old school with chalk and chalkboard and has a pretty thick accent. Don't super recommend. I'm also a very average student so. Good luck chem majors.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took this class online during COVID-19 so this wasn't the most ideal situation, but Gabbai is SO kind!! His lectures aren't as helpful as the book and his accent is a little difficult to understand, but the online homework is crazy helpful.

Singlehandedly, the most clutch professor in the Chemistry department. Makes material clear and does examples in class. French accent but that makes the lecture more interesting. Humorous guy and has a passion for teaching and research. Super cool professor

Professor Gabbai was a really good professor and you definitely had to read the textbook to keep up with the material every lecture. There was a pop quiz every week so be sure to read that textbook to be be prepared! Also a lot of homework but the homework helps you understand the material better! Don't be afraid to ask questions he's super nice!
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Even though Dr. Gabbai is a sweet man, his class is not easy. It is for chem majors so it is not meant to be easy. His tests are difficult and many times include things he did not go over specifically, they are all conceptual questions. He also promised to lower the grade cutoffs (so an 86 was an A) but changed his mind after the final.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof. Gabbai was the kindest teacher ever. He would always stop his hands to answer my questions. He teaches the concepts very clearly and the workload is fair (about 3 hours a week maybe?) Best of all, he responds to emails! His accent is funny but I'll take it :)

Good Professor! He'll go out of his way to help you and his tests are more about concepts. Quizzes are not hard, they are there just to make sure you are understanding the material. His accent was really hard for me to understand so the textbook was a huge help. Use the OWL course, it has tons of extra study help.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: He does have an accent that's easy to understand after a bit, but he is a very caring professor and held many help sessions aside from usual office hours, especially before tests. Great professor.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Gabbai is really nice and offers a lot of outside help. Chemistry isn't an easy class, but he does his best to make it as easy as possible. He tries really hard to help you in anyway he can. Does have a french accent that can be hard to understand at first, but you get used to it. Most test questions are really straightforward and aren't hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS
